Cathedral of Saint Vincent de Paul, Tunis
mapIdentity.scope: Named OpenStreetMap way 100080986 (Q2296514) identifies 22 distinct corners of the cathedral footprint. The 2018 cathedral vicar’s survey establishes the 75 m length and 32 m transept width.

note: The cathedral vicar’s architectural history records the triple arched porch supported by paired columns, façade mosaic, grand rose window, twin square towers with tiara-like cupolas and Lorraine crosses, crossing dome and rounded apse. The Church inventory describes pale stone from Djebel-Oust and the 1910 tower completion.
